headline: Mbappé scores as France leads Iraq 1-0 at halftime
summary: Kylian Mbappé finds the net in his 100th international appearance, moving closer to the top of the World Cup all-time scoring list.
details: Kylian Mbappé scored a stunning goal in the 14th minute, giving France a 1-0 lead over Iraq at the end of the first half of their second World Cup match.
The Real Madrid striker scored with a powerful left-footed shot from outside the penalty box during his milestone 100th international appearance.
This marks Mbappé's third goal of the current tournament and his 15th World Cup goal overall, tying him with former Brazilian legend Ronaldo Nazário on the all-time scoring list.
With this achievement, only two players now stand above him in the World Cup scoring records: Miroslav Klose (16) and Lionel Messi (18).
France continued to pressure the Iraqi defense throughout the first half, though they were unable to convert further chances into goals before the break.
caption:
Mbappé marks his 100th international match with a goal! 🇫🇷

Kylian Mbappé scored a stunning goal in the 14th minute, giving France a 1-0 lead over Iraq at the end of the first half of their second World Cup match.

The Real Madrid striker scored with a powerful left-footed shot from outside the penalty box during his milestone 100th international appearance.

This marks Mbappé's third goal of the current tournament and his 15th World Cup goal overall, tying him with former Brazilian legend Ronaldo Nazário on the all-time scoring list.

With this achievement, only two players now stand above him in the World Cup scoring records: Miroslav Klose (16) and Lionel Messi (18).

France continued to pressure the Iraqi defense throughout the first half, though they were unable to convert further chances into goals before the break.
